title: Writing the Sugar Bowl Parade with Pete Fountain
summary: Hirsch shows the memo sheet and press on the Sugar Bowl Parade, which he wrote with Pete Fountain and lyricist Dick Brown, adopted as the official Sugar Bowl song in 1963.
